name: BUSCAP
recent: Bus Cap 近期与 StarCharge 签署两年合作协议，探索电动车充电基础设施及技术服务，并接收首辆马来西亚 DENZA D9 Prestige AWD，与 BYD 展开商用电动车合作。公司同时出现董事在公开市场减持股份，以及交易所对异常市场活动（UMA）的询问。
notable: 与 StarCharge Energy 签署两年合作协议，探索电动车充电基础设施及技术服务。
接收首辆马来西亚 DENZA D9 Prestige AWD，与 BYD 展开商用电动车合作。
委任 MA XIYIN 为董事，董事会成员出现变动。
risks: 交易所就公司股票异常市场活动（UMA）发出询问。
董事 Puan Aliza Binti Ashari 在 10 月多次在公开市场减持股份。
董事 Puan Rose Zilawati Binti Mohamed Arifin 在 10 月于公开市场减持股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间，公司录得营收 MYR 26,947,000，净利 MYR 2,070,000，净利率 7.7%。

recent_en: Bus Cap recently signed a two-year collaboration with StarCharge to explore EV charging infrastructure and technical services, and took delivery of Malaysia's first DENZA D9 Prestige AWD amid a commercial EV collaboration with BYD. Meanwhile, directors disposed shares in the open market and the exchange issued an unusual market activity (UMA) query.
notable_en: Signed a two-year collaboration agreement with StarCharge Energy to explore EV charging infrastructure and technical services.
Took delivery of Malaysia's first DENZA D9 Prestige AWD amid a commercial EV collaboration with BYD.
Appointed MA XIYIN to the board, resulting in a change in boardroom composition.
risks_en: The exchange issued an unusual market activity (UMA) query on the company's shares.
Director Puan Aliza Binti Ashari disposed shares in the open market multiple times in October.
Director Puan Rose Zilawati Binti Mohamed Arifin disposed shares in the open market in October.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, the company recorded revenue of MYR 26,947,000 and net income of MYR 2,070,000, with a net margin of 7.7%.
